an4.17:1.1: ti Cattār' imāni bhikkhave agatigamanāni. Katamāni cattāri? Chandāgatiṃ gacchati, dosāgatiṃ gacchati, mohāgatiṃ gacchati, bhayāgatiṃ gacchati. Imāni kho bhikkhave cattāri agatigamanānīti.
an4.17:2.1: Chandā dosā bhayā mohā yo dhammam ativattati Nihīyati tassa yaso kāḷapakkhe va candimāti
